text:
Mascot ties for 56th among Tennessee cities in BBB scam reports in June
Mascot was one of 81 cities tied for 56th among 136 Tennessee cities that had at least one BBB Scam Tracker report in June 2026, recording one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
The city had no scam reports listed in the previous month.
The report listed a $478 loss from another scam. The description stated: "I ordered on Facebook hair vitamin for 68 00 dollars i got in the mail a package with all Cain of vitamin there charges me 239 00 a month later there'send me the same and charged me 239 00 again i send both package back on April 16 been 2 .months i still dont got my refund i called many times"
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to show large financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
